title: Spatial Selection and the Multiscale Dynamics of Urban Change
abstract: arXiv:2511.06165v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Growth is a multi-layered phenomenon in human societies, composed of socioeconomic and demographic change at many different scales. Yet, standard macroeconomic indicators average over most of these processes, blurring the spatial and hierarchical heterogeneity driving people's choices and experiences. To address this gap, we introduce here a framework based on the Price equation to decompose aggregate growth exactly into endogenous and selection effects across nested spatial scales. We illustrate this approach with population and income data from the Chicago metropolitan area (2014-2019) and show that both growth rates and spatial selection effects are most intense at local levels, fat-tailed and spatially correlated. We also find that selection, defined as the covariance between prevailing income and relative population change, is concentrated in few spatial units and exhibits scaling behavior when grouped by county. translated_title: 空间选择与城市变化的多尺度动力学
translated_abstract: 增长是人类社会中一个多层次的现象，由许多不同尺度上的社会经济和人口变化构成。然而，标准的宏观经济指标对其中大部分过程进行了平均，模糊了驱动人们选择和体验的空间与层级异质性。为填补这一空白，我们在此引入一个基于普莱斯方程的框架，将总体增长精确地分解为嵌套空间尺度上的内生效应与选择效应。我们以芝加哥都会区（2014-2019年）的人口和收入数据为例展示了这一方法，结果表明增长率和空间选择效应在地方层面最为强烈，呈厚尾分布且具有空间相关性。我们还发现，选择——定义为流行收入与相对人口变化之间的协方差——集中在少数空间单元中，并且在按县分组时表现出标度行为。
tldr: 本文提出基于普莱斯方程的框架，将城市总体增长精确分解为嵌套空间尺度上的内生效应与选择效应，并利用芝加哥都会区数据揭示增长率和空间选择效应在地方层面最为强烈、呈厚尾且空间相关，选择效应集中于少数空间单元并在县级层面表现出标度行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Price equation-based framework that exactly decomposes aggregate urban growth into endogenous and selection effects across nested spatial scales, revealing with Chicago metropolitan data that growth rates and spatial selection effects are most intense at local levels—fat-tailed, spatially correlated, concentrated in few spatial units, and exhibiting county-level scaling behavior.
